# CareerMap AI

> Spatial Career Discovery & Real-Time Job Intelligence across India. Designed for engineering students, self-taught developers, and hiring managers to discover geo-located tech opportunities, master structured learning roadmaps, and track hands-on coding achievements.

## Main Navigation & Core Features

- [Student Dashboard](https://careermap-ai.vercel.app/dashboard): Real-time learning progress, active module mastery, and AI-generated personalized milestones.
- [Spatial Job Map](https://careermap-ai.vercel.app/dashboard?tab=map): Interactive geo-located map of tech companies and engineering jobs across tier-1, tier-2, and tier-3 Indian hubs.
- [Classroom Courses](https://careermap-ai.vercel.app/courses): Structured video courses covering Full-Stack MERN, Machine Learning, Data Structures & Algorithms, Linux, and Data Science.
- [Code Playground](https://careermap-ai.vercel.app/code): In-browser IDE powered by Monaco editor with instant syntax compilation and coding assessments.
- [Company Directory](https://careermap-ai.vercel.app/dashboard?tab=companies): Verified technology companies, hiring trends, salary benchmarks, and tech stacks.
- [Student Profile](https://careermap-ai.vercel.app/profile): Verified resume parsing, skills radar, milestone streaks, and certificate portfolio.

## Technical Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Frosted Glassmorphism, Dual Theme (Light & Ember Dark)
- **Mapping**: MapLibre GL, Vector Tile Clustering, Spatial Geolocation
- **State & Database**: Firebase Firestore, Browser Local Persistence
- **AI Core**: Resume Parser, Real-time Job Matching Score, Daily AI Task Generator
